name: Photography, Documentary & Media Support
summary: Ground logistics and local coordination for photographers, documentary makers, journalists and media teams working in Afghanistan.
description: Planning for photographers, documentary makers, journalists and media crews, shaped on inquiry around your photography objectives, season, preferred locations, access and local operating conditions, as well as your reporting or production brief. Support combines light-aware pacing, location access, fixers, translators and practical ground logistics. This is a specialist service with a personal quotation, not a fixed day-by-day itinerary or scheduled departure.
audience: Photographers, documentary makers, visual storytellers, journalists and media teams
planning_notes: Share project goals or story focus, preferred regions, team size, equipment, deadlines, privacy or sensitivity constraints, and timing. We reply from Kabul with workable options and a written quotation. Access is confirmed case by case; requested locations cannot be guaranteed.
accommodation_note: Best available local hotels suited to the team and route, including hotels accustomed to international visitors where available; confirmed during planning.
transport_note: Private vehicles with experienced drivers and domestic flights where useful for the brief.
support_note: Local guides, drivers, fixers and translators, location coordination, and scheduling support matched to light, access, production needs and reporting deadlines where workable.
availability_note: Arranged on your dates by proposal, subject to season, access and current operating conditions.

name: Scientific & Research Support
summary: Logistical planning for researchers, academics, and field teams — without a fixed expedition package.
description: We help plan routes, ground transport, lodging, interpreters and fixers, and the day-to-day coordination your fieldwork needs.
planning_notes: Share research aims, preferred windows, team size, equipment needs, and any institutional requirements. Access and site conditions are confirmed case by case.
accommodation_note: Best available local hotels, clean and well-located.
transport_note: Domestic flights and 4WD vehicles as your plan requires.
support_note: Drivers, guides, translators, and local coordination arranged to match the brief where workable.
availability_note: Scheduled by proposal around your window and current operating conditions.

name: Media & Journalist Support
summary: Ground logistics and coordination for journalists and media teams working in Afghanistan.
description: Practical planning for reporters and media crews: transport, lodging, fixers and translators, and route timing around current conditions.
planning_notes: Contact early with a clear brief (story focus, team size, equipment, deadlines). We scope what is workable; we do not guarantee access to every requested location.
accommodation_note: Hotels accustomed to hosting international visitors where available.
transport_note: Private vehicles with experienced drivers; domestic flights when useful.
support_note: Fixer/translator options and schedule coordination as the brief requires.
availability_note: Arranged on your dates — just tell us when you need to travel.

name: Business & Investment Visits
summary: Ground support for business visitors, scouting trips, and investment-related travel.
description: Meetings, site visits and ground logistics, coordinated by our local team around permits and conditions.
planning_notes: Share meeting cities, sector context, group size, and timing. We confirm what is workable; we do not guarantee introductions.
transport_note: Private vehicles; airport meets; intercity options as needed.
support_note: Scheduling support and local coordination for the visit plan.

name: Noshaq Expedition Support
summary: Field logistics for Noshaq and other high-altitude expeditions, planned around your climb.
description: Mountaineering and remote-access logistics: transport into Badakhshan and the Wakhan when conditions allow, lodging, local coordination, and support sized to your expedition.
planning_notes: Share objectives, experience level, season, team size, and support expectations. We confirm feasibility honestly around current access and conditions.
accommodation_note: A mix of hotels and field camps, depending on your route.
transport_note: Flights, 4WD, and specialist arrangements as required by the brief.
support_note: Local support, porters/animals, and coordination scaled to the expedition.

name: Ski Expedition Support
summary: Tailored support for ski and snow-travel projects beyond our Bamyan Skiing Tour.
description: Custom ski and winter logistics planned around snow conditions, access and your objectives — for projects beyond our scheduled Bamyan Skiing Tour.
audience: Skiers and winter expedition teams seeking bespoke support
planning_notes: Share ability level, preferred massifs or valleys, timing, and group size. We scope what is workable for the season.
transport_note: 4WD and seasonal access arrangements as required.
support_note: Local coordination matched to winter travel realities.
